claim: AWS processes and stores customer content in the Regions where you use the services; the global services IAM, AWS Organizations, Amazon CloudFront, Amazon Route 53, AWS Global Accelerator, AWS Direct Connect, AWS Firewall Manager, AWS WAF and AWS Shield may store and process data globally.
question: Which services may store customer data outside the Region you chose?

values.display: AWS services process and store customer content in the AWS region(s) where the services are used by the customer
values.spoken: your data stays in your Region, except for the global services

values.display: may store and process data globally

evidence.quote: AWS services process and store customer content in the AWS region(s) where the services are used by the customer. Except as otherwise specified, Global Services—AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), AWS Organizations, Amazon CloudFront, Amazon Route53, AWS Global Accelerator, AWS Direct Connect, AWS Firewall Manager, AWS Web Application Firewall (WAF), and AWS Shield—may store and process data globally.
Amazon CloudFront, Amazon Route 53, AWS Firewall Manager, AWS Shield, and AWS WAF services are provided through AWS Edge Locations.
